info.title: Datagma Universal API
info.description: Datagma enriches B2B people and company data, finds verified work emails and phone numbers, detects job changes, and resolves Twitter identities from contact data.

get.summary: Enrich a person or a company
get.description: Retrieves person or company enrichment data from Datagma.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: Primary enrichment input such as a company name, domain, website, SIREN number, LinkedIn URL, or email address.

schema.description: Primary enrichment input such as a company name, domain, website, SIREN number, LinkedIn URL, or email address.

parameters.name: full_name
parameters.description: Target person's full name when enriching a person.

schema.description: Target person's full name when enriching a person.

parameters.name: phone_full
parameters.description: Set true to find a mobile phone number from a full name and company name.

schema.description: Set true to find a mobile phone number from a full name and company name.

parameters.name: company_premium
parameters.description: Include basic company information in the response.

schema.description: Include basic company information in the response.

parameters.name: company_full
parameters.description: Include extended company information in the response.

schema.description: Include extended company information in the response.

parameters.name: whatsapp_check
parameters.description: Set true to verify whether a found number is linked to WhatsApp.

schema.description: Set true to verify whether a found number is linked to WhatsApp.

parameters.name: debug
parameters.description: Set false to allow broader scoring results; defaults to false.

schema.description: Set false to allow broader scoring results; defaults to false.

parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.
